{"cells":[{"cell_type":"markdown","metadata":{},"source":"# Kaggriculture: More Wheat, Smarter Sales

A farming controller that combines scheduled crop and livestock work with reactive market decisions. Producing a crop is only half the job: an opponent selling first can exhaust demand before our goods reach the market.

The sale predictor now keeps up to three historical opponent trajectories whose matching scores are within one point of the strongest trajectory, when that strongest score is nonnegative. If any retained trajectory predicts a substantial milk, wool or strawberry sale in the next two turns, the controller can bring forward an already planned sale. It checks our actual stock after worker actions and preserves the ten-order limit. Weakly matched histories keep the original single-trajectory rule.

This handles uncertainty about the opponent’s next sale without increasing the reservation horizon or changing the productive routes. It can sell too early when an alternative forecast is wrong, sacrificing subsequent recovery in market prices.

{"cells":[{"cell_type":"markdown","metadata":{},"source":"# Kaggriculture: More Wheat, Smarter Sales

A farming controller that combines scheduled crop and livestock work with reactive market decisions. Producing a crop is only half the job: an opponent selling first can exhaust demand before our goods reach the market.

The sale predictor now keeps up to three historical opponent trajectories whose matching scores are within one point of the strongest trajectory, when that strongest score is nonnegative. If any retained trajectory predicts a substantial milk, wool or strawberry sale in the next two turns, the controller can bring forward an already planned sale. It checks our actual stock after worker actions and preserves the ten-order limit. Weakly matched histories keep the original single-trajectory rule.

This handles uncertainty about the opponent’s next sale without increasing the reservation horizon or changing the productive routes. It can sell too early when an alternative forecast is wrong, sacrificing subsequent recovery in market prices.
